description.purpose: Baseline self-service fix. A customer-accessible drain filter is blocked on a model whose manual documents the cleaning procedure. The agent should identify the model, find the procedure, guide the customer through it, confirm the machine drains, and record a self-service resolution WITHOUT opening a case or booking a visit.
